name: gibo
description: Five skills that record, recall, and review project-owned investment memory, with OpenBB, OpenDART, and KRX data connections. Based on Guru Maker and adapted for Claude Code.

dart_api_key.title: OpenDART API key
dart_api_key.description: 40-character key from opendart.fss.or.kr for the dart connection. Leave empty to use the macOS Keychain item opendart-api-key.

krx_id.title: KRX Data Marketplace ID
krx_id.description: ID of an ID/password account on data.krx.co.kr (Kakao/Naver sign-in accounts do not work) for the krx connection. Leave empty to use the macOS Keychain item krx-data-login.

krx_password.title: KRX Data Marketplace password
krx_password.description: Password for the KRX ID above.
